detail.longDescription: Hello Mastodon 👋 TalkPix turns a photo into a talking video: a portrait, a pet or a product says your script. New this week: it also works inside Claude and ChatGPT as an MCP connector. The assistant quotes the price before every render, and your per-video and per-day budget is enforced on our side, not in the prompt.
